title: Scalar comparison of compact-support system Hom
statement:
theorem integralDualizing_support_system_hom_comparison
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (G : CoefPairingSystem l E (finiteDualizingCompactification D X) S) :
    Nonempty (integralDualizingSupportSystemHom D l E X S G ≅
      (integralDualizingCompactSections l E D hl X).op ⋙
        integralDualizingCoefficientHomTower l E)

source.place: Second proof paragraph: finite mapping-complex comparisons and reduction-compatible counits.

proof.text: Obtain a normalized derived reduction calculus B at the base point from coefficientDerivedSystemEvaluationCalculus. Apply integralDualizing_support_reduction: the actual integral support functor F has constructible values and F followed by B.reduction is naturally isomorphic to the quotient-system support. Lift F to the full subcategory of integral constructible point objects using the constructibility conclusion.

Apply point_integral_reduction_hom_tower to B and G.baseTensors. This compares quotient-system Hom from reduced integral point complexes into the regular unit with Hom from their actual R-module sections into the quotient R-module tower.

Pass the support reduction comparison to opposite functors, reversing its direction, and whisker by Hom into the quotient unit followed by sections. Whisker the point comparison by the lifted support functor and compose the two natural isomorphisms. The final covariant section functor is definitionally integralDualizingCompactSections.
